question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

His father was **__few proud__** of his power over the horse.
solution:
The correct answer is: **very proud.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence **"His father was few proud of his power over the horse" **contains an error.
 
• The word "few" is incorrect in this context. It should be replaced with the word "**very**" to convey a strong sense of pride.
 
• "**Very**" is an **adverb **that intensifies the adjective "**proud**" and emphasizes the degree of pride.
 
• In this corrected sentence,** "very proud"** accurately describes the level of pride the father feels towards his power over the horse. 
 
• The adverb "**very**" modifies the adjective "**proud**," emphasizing the intensity of the emotion.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

**Correct Sentence**__:* "His father was __**very proud**__ of his power over the horse."*
